player_prompt.intro:
D kečč  {role} di Colonel Blotto.
Lɣer-ik d aseɣzif n wučči meqqren n yirnawen ɣef umsaxsab-ik.
Di yirnawen yal, qreb tafat {num_total_units} n yimawlan ɣef yigenniwen {field_names}.
Amsaxsab i qreb yimawlan meqqren ɣef yigenni, yernu amsaxsab i yernu yigenni meqqren yernu yirnawen.
Ameskan, '[A7 B7 C6]' qreb 7 n yimawlan ɣef A, 7 ɣef B, d 6 ɣef C.
